_README: PIXELTOSSA art manifest. This file is the ONLY thing that decides whether a visual
element is a sprite or a procedural drawing. Game.gd never names a PNG.
1. author the art on a 320x180-density canvas (see _AUTHORING below)
2. save it into the matching Assets/ folder
3. add a line here, keyed by the seam key
4. run the game - that element is now a sprite; delete the line to go back
A key with no line here draws procedurally, exactly as `main` does. A line whose
file is missing logs one warning and falls back, so you can reserve a key before
the art exists. Keys beginning with _ are documentation and are skipped.
TO SEE THE LIVE KEY LIST, run the game with:  --artreport
It prints every key the running session actually reached, marked [sprite] or [proc].
That list is generated from the code, so it can never go stale the way this comment
can. The _KEYS block below is a convenience copy, correct as of the branch point.

_AUTHORING.canvas: 320x180 is the art's pixel density; the game's coordinate space stays 1280x720
_AUTHORING.scale: 1 art pixel is drawn as a 4x4 screen block (ART_PIXEL = 4), no resampling
_AUTHORING.rule: author at 1/4 the screen size you want, e.g. a 24px-wide ball on screen = 6px of art
_AUTHORING.import: PNG, lossless, no mipmaps, nearest filter - project.godot's importer_defaults does this
_AUTHORING.tint: props/hands/gear are drawn with the game's colour as a TINT, so author them WHITE
_AUTHORING.pivot: [0.5,0.5] is the centre; [0.5,1.0] pins the bottom edge to the draw position
_AUTHORING.scale_field: optional multiplier if the art is authored bigger or smaller than its slot

_KEYS.prop/*: ball egg ring club knife torch chainsaw  (Assets/Props/, tinted, rotated)
_KEYS.char/*: head head_back hat_top glasses helmet boot hand_open hand_closed glove_open glove_closed
_KEYS.bg/*: backyard street_corner small_theatre the_circus championship world_arena midnight_show
_KEYS.ui/*: keycap card_skill card_trick gear_glasses gear_pie gear_gloves ...

_LIVE: Below are the real, registered sprites. Everything else in the game is still drawn by
code. Generated by scripts/gen_prop_art.gd, which prints these lines ready to paste -
the pivots come from the drawing constants, not from eyeballing, because a club tumbles
about y=0 of a -22.5..+17.8 shape and that is 55.8% down the sprite, not 50%.
Delete any line to send that prop back to procedural. Run with --procart to A/B them all.
